pr_body:
This configuration option allows to set a string with template
values for precise control over snapshot path location.

An example of `snapshotPathTemplate` usage:

```ts
// playwright.config.ts
// Notice the `testDir` configuration!
export default {
  testDir: './tests',
  snapshotPathTemplate: './__screenshots__/{platform}/{projectName}/{testFilePath}/{arg}{ext}',
}
```

Currently supported "magic tokens" inside the `snapshotPathTemplate`
are:

- `{testDir}` - project's `testDir`
- `{snapshotDir}` - project's `snapshotDir`
- `{platform}` - `process.platform`
- `{projectName}` - Project's sanitized name
- `{testFileDir}` - Directories in relative path from `testDir` to test
  file path (e.g. `page/` in the example below)
- `{testFileName}` - Test file name (with extension) (e.g.
  `page-click.spec.ts` in the example below)
- `{testFilePath}` - Relative path from `testDir` to test file path
  (e.g. `page/page-click.spec.ts` in the example below)
- `{ext}` - snapshot extension (with dots)
- `{arg}` - joined snapshot name parts, without extension (e.g. `foo/bar/baz` in the example below)
- `{snapshotSuffix}` - `testInfo.snapshotSuffix` value.

Consider the following file structure:

```
playwright.config.ts
tests/
└── page/
    └── page-click.spec.ts
```

The following `page-click.spec.ts`:

```ts
// page-click.spec.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('should work', async ({ page }) => {
  await expect(page).toHaveScreenshot(['foo', 'bar', 'baz.png']);
});
```

Fixes #7792

issue_context.title: [Feature]: Can I somehow change the directory for saving screenshots?
issue_context.body:
### Your question

I used this https://playwright.dev/java/docs/test-snapshots function
Can I somehow change the directory for saving screenshots?
comments:
*Which language are you using? This page you refer to is for Java, it should not have test-snapshot section.*/

I assume you use JavaScript. Snapshot paths  are not configurable when you are using `expect.toMatchSnapshot`. But you can `page.screenshot({ path })` into any desired location.

Could you share more about your use case?
@pavelfeldman Yes I used JavaScript. Can you give an example of how you can save screenshots one level higher than the current test?
It's not possible currently, the snapshot files when using toMatchSnapshot are always next to the actual test file (<test-file-name>-snapshots directory). Why does this not work for you?
@mxschmitt it works but it is not convenient. I want to create a shared library of screenshots. And for different tests to refer to it. Now that not possible (
This sounds like a feature request for more control over expected screenshots.
@pavelfeldman hi, very upset that this fix will not be included in the next release. Tell me whether to wait for him at all?
Hello, is there any progress? It would be nice to specify path in `toMatchSnapshot` function.

We have baseline images that are shared across tests, as they are only part of the web page. We use `locator.screenshot()`, not `page.locator()` to get the screenshot.

We can't specify the path to the shared image folder, so we'd have to duplicate our baseline images for every test.
@sebastian-xitaso with Playwright Test 1.28, you can use [`snapshotPathTemplate`](https://playwright.dev/docs/next/api/class-testproject#test-project-snapshot-path-template) configuration option.

This is for `screenshotPath`. The `snapshotPathTemplate` is covered with tests separately
